# Would You Rather

> Would You Rather is a free iOS party game of impossible choices — 1,500+ questions in 11 categories, with shuffle, custom My Cards, and offline play. No account required. Made by Lulo.

Would You Rather is for friends, families, roommates, and anyone who needs a fast party game: road trips, dinners, icebreakers, and late-night “this or that” arguments. It is an iOS app. It is not a website game and it does not require sign-up.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wouldyourather.app/): Product landing page for the Would You Rather iOS app
- [Privacy Policy](https://wouldyourather.app/privacy): How the app handles data (no account required)
- [Full product brief](https://wouldyourather.app/llms-full.txt): Longer factual summary for AI agents
